thread:
Ellen Park: Shared updated launch post draft in Drive — version 11. Link: https://drive.redwood/marketing/launch-v11
Noah Reed: Quick scan: need clarity on the hero claim (bench numbers) and where webinar registrants land in our CRM. small :memo:
Sofia M: For hero claim, let's be specific: "Up to 48% lower per-query cost on doc-search workloads (mosaic-13b, quantized)" with a footnote pointing to methods.
Tom Becker: Agree. Also add the run date in parentheses so it reads like: (benchmarks run 2026-03-18)
Ellen Park: Good. Noah — can you confirm the exact UTM pattern we'll use for hero vs blog body? ops wants consistent naming for attribution.
Noah Reed: Use campaign=prod-launch-q2-2026, source=blog, medium=organic, content=hero|bench. Example hero: `?utm_campaign=prod-launch-q2-2026&utm_source=blog&utm_medium=organic&utm_content=hero`
Sofia M: CTA copy suggestion: Primary = "View benchmarks & register", Secondary = "See full methods". Keeps expectations correct.
Tom Becker: Legal flagged: replace "best" claims — use "validated in our tests" instead. They'll send a tracked redline.
Ellen Park: Noted. Inbound routing: webinar registrants should route to SDR_EMEA queue for first 72h, then fall back to SDR_Global. Also tag leads with `lead_source=blog_post_launch`.
Noah Reed: I'll provide the HubSpot mapping. Example payload we plan to send:
```
{
  "email": "{{email}}",
  "firstName": "{{first_name}}",
  "utm_campaign": "prod-launch-q2-2026",
  "utm_content": "hero",
  "region_hint": "{{region_hint}}",
  "lead_source": "blog_post_launch"
}
```
WebhookBot: payload schema OK. routing rule check: if region_hint in ["EMEA","UK"] -> SDR_EMEA; else -> SDR_Global. Fallback: timezone_offset < 0 -> SDR_EMEA.
Sofia M: Small accessibility note: add alt text for the hero chart: "Cost vs latency for mosaic-13b on docs-search workload" and ensure chart colors are colorblind-safe.
Ellen Park: Thanks. Ops, can we lock the staging publish to 22:00 PT after final signoff? Want a 30min QA window.
Tom Becker: Ops signoff timeline: UTM matrix by 16:00 PT, Legal signoff by 17:00 PT, final QA 17:30-18:00 PT, staging push at 22:00 PT. Ops will enable webhook test at 21:45 PT.
Noah Reed: I'll drop a CSV with UTMs and CTA mappings in #ops by 15:45 PT.
Sofia M: I'll do a final read at 14:30 PT and check the bench links + methods anchor.
Ellen Park: Perfect. If all green we lock and schedule. Leaving thread open for final redline uploads and the legal signoff. :rocket:
